text: You step into the supermarket, ready to grab your groceries. You just want to get your list done and maybe find a good deal.
A gentle melody floats through the aisles. You might barely notice it, but it makes the environment feel calm and inviting.
Is it just background noise, or is there a clever plan behind these tunes? You might think it's simply to make your shopping experience more pleasant.
But the real genius is how that slow tempo subtly slows *you* down. Your pace matches the rhythm, encouraging you to linger longer in each aisle.
More time spent browsing means more chances to spot things not on your list. That soothing music actually nudges you towards impulse buys, costing you extra time and money.
Next time you’re pushing your cart, listen closely. You’ll hear the system at play, gently guiding your journey, now with open eyes.
